_comment: CCV-L23's declared bypass for ooe_rendep (OA's ruling on OI-72, rev 210; DA's waiver, DA tab rev 72): G-1's lookups read G-2's registers, a cycle-later copy of G-1's own ports, for the entries the grant gives the group ahead, because ooe_prodmap records them a cycle later. One prodmap-record bypass, names and codes. tables: u_map's table, signed by OA (OA-497, re:OI-217).

xr2_cq02h.why: a GPR source's hit on the group ahead's writers, by G-2's names (OA's rev 210)

xp2_cq02h.why: a predicate source's hit on the group ahead's writers, by G-2's names (OA's rev 210)

g2cv_e_cq02h.why: the codes of the entries the grant gives the group ahead, by G-2's codes (OA's rev 210)

eg_cq01h.why: u_map's table, read a stage before G-1's write lands (OA-496, OI-215): u_map writes G-1's names at the parent's 04 (m_*_cq04h), and u_dep reads the entries at 03, never the cycle they are written; the hits the read cannot yet see are G-1's, which prv_dep carries (prv_carries_g1), and G-2's, which the declared G-2 bypass carries.
